captions: Orte
The participants of the project chose a place to make the subject of their
investigation. This investigation could take place freely or according to previously
conceived methods. The places could be represented in themselves, in their
function, in their meaning as a possibility for social processes, in their poetic and
emotional dimension, in their spatial and temporal structure, in their openings and
delimitations, in their history or in many other contexts.
Exhibited in the Künstlerhaus Bethanien under the name of “Sichtweisen”.
Education: Seminars: Orte
Exhibition Design by Anisia Affek and Caroline Breidenbach.
Website about homeless-shelter in Berlin, where she worked on the weekly newspaper. By Bea Naomi Davies.
